scope: R-007 minimal MMIO candidate built from the existing step14 probe: exactly two read-only DSI timing-enable loads, no wait, no write
reason: R-006 left the timeout on the post-dispatch display path. The main hypothesis is that the first access to an unpowered MDP/DSI domain hangs the bus, which would be independent of how many registers a probe reads. step14 is the smallest existing read (two loads) and shares stage/GUID/detail with the failed step20 image, so the only variable is probe depth.

timing_classes.pass_fast_return: probe returns the pass encoding, checkpoint resets immediately, adb expected around 16-18 s
timing_classes.fail_fallback_return: probe returns the fail encoding so the gate does not fire, CoreDispatcher completes, the 7 s completion fallback resets, adb expected several seconds later
timing_classes.stall: no return within 75 s, which the fallback explicitly cannot recover

discrimination.any_stall: two MMIO loads alone are enough to hang, so the unpowered-domain/bus hypothesis stands and probe depth is irrelevant
discrimination.all_return: touching the DSI window twice is safe across trials; the failure then belongs to deeper offsets or to the longer read sequence, not to first contact

hardware_order: same immediate identity/backup/recovery gate as R-006, one temporary boot per trial
